info.title: FSHRMS — Employee API
info.description:
Employee records, org structure (departments, sections, designations,
grades), location catalogs, and the onboarding + termination sagas.
Catalog endpoints are HR-managed; ESS endpoints under /employees/me
let an employee view and edit a small set of fields on themselves.

tags.name: Employees — Identity Resolver
tags.description: Authenticated-only batch lookup keyed by user id. Returns profile-picture URL + display name only, so the BFF can render chat / mention chips without granting `employee.read` to every viewer.

tags.name: Employees — Lifecycle
tags.description: Suspensions and exits (resignation / termination / retirement). Auth-side disable / re-enable is driven by `employee.suspended` / `employee.suspension_lifted` / `employee.terminated` events. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: Catalogs — Departments
tags.description: Top-level org units. Departments are flat — no nesting. Reads are open to any authenticated user (label resolution on the ESS profile screen needs them); writes require `employee.write`.

tags.name: Employees — Profile Picture
tags.description: Avatar upload uses the same two-step flow as documents but lives on a separate column so list-view queries don't need to join the documents table. Requires `employee.write`.

tags.name: Disciplinary Actions
tags.description: HR records warnings as flat rows; decisions (UPHELD / WITHDRAWN) close them. Per-employee list returns computed FY warning counts (UPHELD only). Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: People analytics
tags.description: JSON aggregations for the /analytics dashboards. Requires `employee.analytics.read`.

tags.name: Disabilities
tags.description: Disability category catalog (PWD ordinance compliance). Read for everyone, CRUD for HR. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.admin`.

tags.name: Employees — Certifications
tags.description: Per-employee certifications + the global expiring queue HR uses to chase renewals. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: Employees — Skills
tags.description: Per-employee proficiency on catalog skills, plus the reverse-lookup endpoint. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: Employees — Prior Experience
tags.description: Pre-Forward-Sports employment history. Captured by HR from the candidate's CV. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: Employees — Composites
tags.description: Read-only composites that join employee rows with catalog labels. Replaces the legacy BFF composites that fanned out via HTTP for what is ultimately one service's data.

tags.name: Catalogs — Cities
tags.description: Pakistan cities catalog (scoped to a province). Reads are open to any authenticated user (label resolution on the ESS profile screen needs them); writes require `employee.write`.

tags.name: Self-serve
tags.description: Endpoints for the signed-in employee — view own record, patch contact fields, list direct reports, manage own emergency contacts and profile picture, and read-only views over the side tables HR populates (skills, qualifications, certifications, prior experience, contracts, suspensions, exit and history).

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: HR-facing employee CRUD, onboarding, assignment changes, and ESS grant/revoke. Self-serve `/employees/me` lives on a separate controller. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write` / `employee.admin`.

tags.name: Employees — Disabilities
tags.description: An employee's links to disability categories. Used for PWD ordinance compliance reporting. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: Catalogs — Designations
tags.description: Job-title catalog. Department-agnostic. Reads are open to any authenticated user (label resolution on the ESS profile screen needs them); writes require `employee.write`.

tags.name: Employees — Aggregates
tags.description: Grouped headcount for the People-overview charts. One groupBy per call; the UI fans out for multiple breakdowns. Requires `employee.read`.

tags.name: Employee reports
tags.description: Standard exportable reports owned by employee-service. Requires `employee.reports.run`. Manager callers see only their reportees.

tags.name: Catalogs — Skills
tags.description: Global skill catalog. Per-employee proficiency lives elsewhere. Reads are open to any authenticated user (label resolution on the ESS profile screen needs them); writes require `employee.write`.

tags.name: Sagas
tags.description: Visibility into durable saga rows (onboarding ESS provisioning, termination disable, etc.). Operators use these to inspect the status of an in-flight saga and to re-arm a FAILED one once the underlying issue is resolved. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: Catalogs — Provinces
tags.description: Pakistan provinces / federal areas. Soft-deactivated, never deleted. Reads are open to any authenticated user (label resolution on the ESS profile screen needs them); writes require `employee.write`.

tags.name: Catalogs — Grades
tags.description: Seniority grades. `level` orders rows; higher = more senior. Reads are open to any authenticated user (label resolution on the ESS profile screen needs them); writes require `employee.write`.

tags.name: Catalogs — Sections
tags.description: Sections are scoped to a single department. Used as the secondary org unit when a department is too coarse. Reads are open to any authenticated user (label resolution on the ESS profile screen needs them); writes require `employee.write`.

tags.name: Employees — Qualifications
tags.description: Per-employee academic-qualification rows + reverse lookup. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: Catalogs — Qualifications
tags.description: Global academic-qualification catalog. Per-employee instances live in /employees/{id}/qualifications. Reads are open to any authenticated user (label resolution on the ESS profile screen needs them); writes require `employee.write`.

tags.name: Employees — Emergency Contacts
tags.description: HR-facing CRUD on an employee's emergency contacts. Setting `primary=true` demotes any other primary on the same employee. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

tags.name: Employees — Documents
tags.description: Two-step document upload: ask for a signed PUT URL, upload to MinIO, then POST metadata. Requires `employee.read` / `employee.write`.

Standard Spring `page`, `size`, and `sort` query params apply. Sortable fields: `fullName`, `employeeCode`, `joiningDate`, `confirmationDate`, `departmentId`, `sectionId`, `gradeId`, `managerId`, `employmentStatus`, `employmentType`. **Defaults:** when `status` is omitted, TERMINATED rows are hidden — pass `status=TERMINATED` to list only terminated, or `includeTerminated=true` to see every status. When `sort` is omitted, results are ordered by `employeeCode` ascending. When `probationDueWithin` or `probationOverdue=true` is set, the response is narrowed to employees whose ACTIVE PROBATION contract matches the filter (other filters are ignored for these specialized queries) and each row carries an `activeProbation` summary. Requires `employee.read`.

post.description: Single endpoint for both quick-add (modal) and complete-form (page) flows; quick-add sends only the required identity + assignment fields, complete-form additionally supplies salary, shift, and per-row arrays (qualifications, experience, skills, certifications, emergency contacts, disabilities). The kickoff transaction persists the employee + initial PROBATION contract + history seed + every supplied array, emits `employee.created` via outbox, and registers an ONBOARDING saga whose ordered steps (PROVISION_ESS, SET_BASIC_SALARY, ASSIGN_SALARY_COMPONENTS, SET_BANK_DETAILS, ASSIGN_SHIFT) call auth/payroll/attendance with bounded retry. Steps no-op when their section is absent. Response includes `sagaId` whenever any cross-service work was requested; the FE polls `/sagas/{id}` for per-step RUNNING / COMPLETED / FAILED. Requires `employee.write`.

post.summary: Grant ESS to an existing employee
post.description: Registers an ESS_GRANT saga whose PROVISION_ESS step calls auth-service to create the user and patches `employees.user_id`. Returns the saga id alongside the employee row; the FE polls `GET /sagas/{id}` for RUNNING / COMPLETED / FAILED. The previous in-tx HTTP call risked an orphaned auth user on a kickoff-tx failure; the saga's idempotency-key (`ess-grant:emp:{id}`) makes retries safe. Requires `employee.admin`.

gradeType.description: Role bucket. Drives payroll's canteen rule (management → weekly, supervisor/labour → per-day) and other grade-type policy switches.

OnboardBankDetails.description: Pakistan IBAN + bank catalog reference for salary disbursement.

iban.description: Pakistan IBAN, 24 chars (PK + 2 digits + 4 letters + 16 alphanumerics).

amount.description: Override the catalog default amount (paisa). Null = use default.

primary.description: Mark as the primary contact. The first row with primary=true wins; the rest are stored as non-primary regardless of flag value.

OnboardEmployeeRequest.description: HR payload to onboard a new employee. Quick-add modals send only the required identity + assignment fields; the complete-form page additionally supplies salary, shift, and per-row arrays (qualifications, experience, skills, certifications, emergency contacts, disabilities). Sub-resources owned by employee-service are persisted in the kickoff transaction; salary, salary-components, bank, and shift sit in the saga payload and are applied by ONBOARDING saga steps with bounded retry. ESS provisioning runs as the first saga step when `provisionEss=true`.

provisionEss.description: If true, employee-service calls auth-service to create an ESS user.

username.description: Login name for the ESS user. Required when `provisionEss=true`.

email.description: Email for the ESS user. Optional; uses workEmail when omitted.

temporaryPassword.description: Temporary password for the ESS user. Required when `provisionEss=true`.

qualifications.description: Per-employee qualifications. Persisted in the kickoff tx.

experiences.description: Prior employment history. Persisted in the kickoff tx.

skills.description: Skills + proficiency. Persisted in the kickoff tx.

certifications.description: Professional certifications. Persisted in the kickoff tx.

emergencyContacts.description: Emergency contacts. Persisted in the kickoff tx. Recommend at least one for compliance.

disabilities.description: Registered disabilities. Persisted in the kickoff tx.

salary.description: Salary, allowance/deduction lines, and bank. Applied by SET_BASIC_SALARY / ASSIGN_SALARY_COMPONENTS / SET_BANK_DETAILS saga steps. Omit to skip — payroll-service does not auto-seed; HR sets basic later via POST /salary/employees/{id}. Until then the employee surfaces as a NO_BASIC_SALARY skip row on each compute attempt.

shift.description: Initial shift assignment. Applied by the ASSIGN_SHIFT saga step. Omit to skip — HR can assign later via /shifts/employees/{id}.

OnboardSalarySetup.description: Basic salary + selected allowance/deduction lines + bank for disbursement. All amounts are paisa (1 PKR = 100 paisa).

basic.description: Monthly basic in paisa. Replaces the auto-seeded placeholder.

components.description: Salary components from the catalog (allowances + deductions). Income tax should be entered here as a deduction line with code INCOME_TAX.

bank.description: Bank details for salary disbursement. Optional — can be added later.

OnboardShiftAssignment.description: Initial shift the employee follows from joiningDate.

ActiveProbationDto.description: Per-row active-probation summary for HR's probation queue.

isExtended.description: True iff the probation has already been extended once.

EmployeeDto.description: Employee record — admin lists, get-by-id, post-mutation responses.

userId.description: Linked auth user id (null when ESS not granted).

managerUserId.description: Linked auth user id of the manager. Null when the manager has no ESS user, or when the source path didn't resolve it (mutation responses leave it null).

profilePictureUrl.description: Short-lived signed GET URL for the profile picture. Null when no picture is set or the storage call failed.

essProvisioningStatus.description: ESS provisioning state. On mutation responses reflects only the linked-user check (COMPLETED / NOT_REQUESTED). On read paths the assembler looks up the onboarding saga row to surface RUNNING / FAILED.

directReportsCount.description: Number of non-terminated employees who report to this employee. Populated on read endpoints; null on post-mutation responses.

activeProbation.description: Active-probation summary. Populated only on probation queries (probationDueWithin / probationOverdue) and detail reads.

OnboardEmployeeResponse.description: Response from POST /employees. Wraps the freshly-created employee plus, when any cross-service work was requested (ESS provisioning, basic salary, salary components, bank details, shift assignment), the id of the onboarding saga the FE can poll via GET /sagas/{id} for live per-step status.

employee.description: The created employee. Cross-service work runs out-of-band — the saga's outcome is reflected on subsequent reads (e.g. essProvisioningStatus, payroll, attendance lookups).

sagaId.description: Saga row id, present when at least one cross-service section was requested (provisionEss=true, salary, or shift). Use it on GET /sagas/{id} to surface RUNNING / COMPLETED / FAILED per step in the UI.

reason.description: Why the resignation is being withdrawn.

ExitDto.description: Current or historical exit row for an employee.

TerminateRequest.description: Immediate termination. Last working day = today; emits employee.terminated immediately.

reassignReportsTo.description: If the employee has direct reports, the id of the employee they should be reassigned to. Required when reports exist.

reason.description: Why the employee is being suspended.

withPay.description: When false, payroll counts these days as LOP.

SuspensionDto.description: One row in an employee's suspension history.

endDate.description: Planned end. Null on open-ended suspensions.

withPay.description: When false, suspended days count as LOP for payroll.

EmployeeSkillDto.description: Per-employee proficiency on a catalog skill.

AssignmentChangeRequest.description: Body shared by /employees/{id}/manager, /department, /section, /designation, /grade. Pass `targetId=0` to clear the assignment (where allowed).

lastWorkingDay.description: Last working day; must be in the future.

reassignReportsTo.description: If the employee has direct reports, the id of the employee they should be reassigned to. Required when reports exist.

documentKey.description: MinIO key for an uploaded scan.

EmployeeQualificationDto.description: An employee's instance of a catalog qualification (degree).

documentKey.description: MinIO key for an uploaded transcript / degree.

documentUrl.description: Short-lived signed GET URL for the transcript. Null when no document is attached or the storage call failed.

SetProfilePictureRequest.description: Posted after the client finishes uploading to the pre-signed profile-picture URL.

filename.description: Original filename (used to compute the object key suffix).

bytes.description: Declared object size in bytes. Rejected at pre-sign if above `hrms.employee.documents.avatar-max-size-bytes` (default 2 MB).

UploadUrlResponse.description: Pre-signed PUT URL the client uploads the file directly to. After the upload completes, post the metadata to /documents (or /profile-picture) referencing this objectKey.

objectKey.description: Object key the URL is signed for. Pass this back when recording metadata.

endDate.description: Required — every prior employer has been left.

liftedOn.description: Actual lift date. Defaults to today when omitted.

reason.description: Why the suspension is being lifted.

GrantEssRequest.description: Grant ESS to an existing employee.

username.description: Login name. Falls back to a slug of the employee's full name when omitted.

email.description: Email for the ESS user. Falls back to workEmail.

temporaryPassword.description: Temporary password — user is forced to change at first login.

GrantEssResponse.description: Response from POST /employees/{id}/grant-ess. Wraps the employee row and the id of the saga that drives the auth-service call out-of-band. The FE polls GET /sagas/{id} for live status (RUNNING / COMPLETED / FAILED).

employee.description: The employee row at kickoff time. `userId` is patched onto the row by the saga's PROVISION_ESS step; subsequent reads will reflect it.

sagaId.description: Saga row id. Always present; the auth call always runs through the saga.

ExtendProbationRequest.description: One-time extension of an active PROBATION contract. newProbationDays must be 120 or 180, and greater than the current probation_days.

newProbationDays.description: New total probation length in days. Allowed: 120 or 180.

primary.description: Mark as the primary contact. Demotes any other primary on this employee.

RecordDocumentRequest.description: Posted after the client finishes uploading to the pre-signed URL. Service verifies the object exists in MinIO before persisting.

EmployeeDocumentDto.description: Stored document metadata + a short-lived signed download URL.

UploadUrlRequest.description: Ask for a pre-signed PUT URL. The service crafts the object key from employeeId / docType / a UUID; the client uploads to the URL and then POSTs the metadata back.

filename.description: Original filename — used to compute the suffix on the object key.

contentType.description: Optional content-type hint stored alongside the metadata.

bytes.description: Declared object size in bytes. The server rejects pre-sign requests above `hrms.employee.documents.max-size-bytes` (default 10 MB) and re-checks the actual size at record-time.

reason.description: Short narrative — what the employee did.

AddEmployeeDisabilityRequest.description: Link an employee to a disability category. (employeeId, disabilityId) is unique.

description.description: Free-text description for compliance reporting. Use this for the specific impairment phrase (legacy WebHRMS stored 78 distinct values).

documentKey.description: Object key in the employee-docs bucket for the supporting medical certificate.

ConfirmEmployeeRequest.description: Confirm an employee out of probation.

notes.description: Optional confirmation notes recorded on the new permanent contract.

employeeCode.description: Denormalized employee code; only filled on the global expiring queue.

fullName.description: Denormalized employee name; only filled on the global expiring queue.

documentUrl.description: Short-lived signed GET URL for the certificate scan. Null when no document is attached or the storage call failed.

DecideDisciplinaryRequest.description: Close out an ISSUED disciplinary action. UPHELD rows count toward warning totals; WITHDRAWN rows do not.

CreateDisabilityRequest.description: HR-admin create payload for the disability catalog. `code` is unique and immutable post-create — referenced by employee_disabilities.

DisabilityDto.description: Disability category catalog. Used for compliance reporting under the Persons with Disabilities (Employment & Rehabilitation) ordinance.

category.description: DIRECT (production-line / labour) vs INDIRECT (office / admin). Optional — null when the distinction does not apply.
DIRECT (production-line) vs INDIRECT (office / admin). Null when the distinction does not apply.

isProduction.description: Marks the department as a production unit (factory floor). Defaults to false.

DepartmentDto.description: Top-level org unit. Departments are flat — no nesting.

headId.description: Department head's employee id, if assigned.

isProduction.description: Marks the department as a production unit (factory floor).

CityDto.description: City in Pakistan, scoped to a province.

displayOrder.description: HR-controlled sort order; lower sorts first.

UpdateSkillRequest.description: Patch a skill. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateSectionRequest.description: Patch a section. Null fields are left unchanged.

headId.description: Section head's employee id. Pass `0` to clear.

UpdateQualificationRequest.description: Patch a qualification. Null fields are left unchanged.

ReorderEntryRequest.description: One entry of a bulk reorder payload — the new displayOrder for a catalog row.

displayOrder.description: New display order. Lower sorts first.

UpdateProvinceRequest.description: Patch a province. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateGradeRequest.description: Patch a grade. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateEmployeeRequest.description: HR patch on the employee record. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateEmployeeSkillRequest.description: Patch. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateEmployeeQualificationRequest.description: Patch. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdatePriorExperienceRequest.description: Patch. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateEmergencyContactRequest.description: Patch. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateEmployeeDisabilityRequest.description: Patch the description / severity / document key. The disability id itself is immutable — to change it, delete the row and add a new one.

UpdateCertificationRequest.description: Patch. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateMeRequest.description: Self-serve patch under /employees/me. Limited to contact + address fields.

cityId.description: City id (provinces resolved via the city join).

UpdateDisabilityRequest.description: HR-admin partial update. Null fields are unchanged. `code` is immutable.

UpdateDesignationRequest.description: Patch a designation. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateDepartmentRequest.description: Patch a department. Null fields are left unchanged.

headId.description: Department head's employee id. Pass `0` to clear.

isProduction.description: Marks the department as a production unit (factory floor).

UpdateCityRequest.description: Patch a city. Null fields are left unchanged.

SkillEmployeeDto.description: Reverse-lookup row: an employee who holds a given skill.

QualificationEmployeeDto.description: Reverse-lookup row: an employee who holds a given qualification.

EmployeeHistoryDto.description: One row of the employee's org-assignment history.

EmployeeHistoryRow.description: Point-in-time assignment row + resolved catalog labels and manager summary.

effectiveTo.description: Inclusive end. Null when this is the current row.

changeReason.description: ONBOARD / TRANSFER / PROMOTION / DEMOTION / DEPARTMENT_CHANGE / MANAGER_CHANGE / SECTION_CHANGE / EXIT.

notes.description: Free-text note captured at the time of change.

raw.description: Raw upstream row, in case the FE wants the unresolved ids.

ManagerSummary.description: Lean view of an employee's direct manager — enough to render the manager strip.

DisciplinaryActionListResponse.description: Per-employee disciplinary list plus computed UPHELD-only warning counts per level for the requested fiscal year.

fyCode.description: Fiscal year code (the calendar year the FY ends in — e.g. 2026 for FY 2025-26).

warningCounts.description: UPHELD-only count per level inside the requested FY window.

EmploymentContractDto.description: One row of the employee's contract history.

documentUrl.description: Short-lived signed GET URL for the contract document. Null when no document is attached or the storage call failed.

EmployeeStats.description: Headline KPIs for the People-overview screen — counts by status / type / probation windows / cert windows / ESS coverage.

byEmploymentType.description: Counts keyed by EmploymentType (excluding TERMINATED rows).

EmployeePickerCandidate.description: Compact picker row: id, name, code, department, designation.

EmployeePickerResponse.description: Response envelope for `/employees/picker` — name + code typeahead.

OrgTree.description: Recursive manager → reports tree, depth-bounded to keep responses sane.

OnboardingLookups.description: Bundle of every catalog the onboarding wizard reads on its first paint. Pulls 8 employee-side endpoints in one round-trip. The wizard fetches `/admin/roles` from auth-service separately when the caller has `auth.users.write`.

HeadcountTrendDto.description: Joiners / leavers / end-of-month headcount over a trailing window. Computed once on the server so the HR dashboard chart can render with one round-trip rather than reducing 12+ queries client-side.

EmployeeDirectoryRow.description: One row in the directory list — employee record + the catalog labels HR's table renders.

resolved.description: Resolved id→label for department, section, designation, grade, city + manager.

EmployeeResolvedLabels.description: Resolved id→label rows for the catalogs the page renders.

DelegationCandidate.description: A user the caller is allowed to delegate approval authority to. Scoped server-side — the caller cannot delegate to themselves, and only employees with active ESS access (a linked auth user) appear. `role` is left null for v1; the FE can fall back to displaying the employee code.

role.description: Reserved for v2 — auth role of the candidate.

DelegationCandidatesResponse.description: List wrapper for the delegation picker. Wrapped (not bare) so future fields (scope, hint counts) can be added without a breaking change.

EmployeeIdentitySummary.description: Identity-only employee row keyed by userId. Returned by the by-user-ids resolver to surface profile-picture URL + display name without requiring `employee.read`.

userId.description: User id this employee is linked to.

fullName.description: Display name (denormalized from auth.user.fullName at onboarding, kept in sync).

profilePictureUrl.description: Pre-signed GET URL for the avatar; null if no picture set.

profilePictureKey.description: Raw object key (callers can re-sign / cache if needed).

key.description: Group key as a string. For id-shaped groupings (department, section, grade, designation) this is the id; for enum-shaped groupings (status, employmentType, gender) this is the enum/value name.

label.description: Optional human-readable label — populated for id-shaped groupings via the catalog row, null otherwise.

AggregateDto.description: Grouped headcount used by overview-page charts. `buckets[]` is one row per group key; `total` is the sum across buckets.

groupBy.description: What field the rows are grouped by.

Authorization.description: Paste the access token returned from POST /auth/login (without the 'Bearer ' prefix).
Authorization.name: Authorization
